title: Shipping cost
description:
A parcel service charges by weight, with an extra fee for express delivery.

| Weight | Base price |
|---|---|
| up to 1 kg | 5 |
| over 1 kg, up to 5 kg | 9 |
| over 5 kg, up to 20 kg | 15 |
| over 20 kg | not accepted |

Express adds 7 to the base price.

Read the weight in kilograms (a decimal) and then `1` for express or `0` for standard. Print one line:

- `Cost: 16` (the price), or
- `Too heavy` if the parcel is over 20 kg, or
- `Invalid weight` if the weight is zero or negative.
hints: Deal with the two error cases first and `return 0;` straight away. Then the rest of the code can assume the weight is sensible.
Work out the base price with an `if / else if / else` chain, then add the express fee with a separate `if`.
